sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: Speaker, time and message body are text. Alignment or avatar alone must not identify the speaker.
updatesAndDescendants: MessageGroup/Message and slots are native div wrappers; align=end reverses visual direction. They do not store messages, send replies, announce streams or manage scrolling. MessageScroller or a caller-owned log region controls those behaviors.
referenceDecision: Speaker/time markup and reply Button are caller-supplied reference children. A live log is a separate context decision, not an unconditional role added to every message.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

group.description: Actual vertical message grouping; no automatic log semantics.

avatar.description: Optional supplementary visual identity; readable speaker remains in header.

header.description: Actual metadata row containing explicit speaker/time text.

footer.description: Actual metadata/action row, not automatic delivery state.
